instruction: Download invoice.pdf from Google Drive, extract all services, and save as 'invoice.xlsx' on the Desktop. Find the 'Domain Registration' service and place its unit price in cell F6.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires downloading invoice.pdf from Google Drive, extracting all services, and saving as invoice.xlsx. metadata.scoring_breakdown: 1.0 if all 6 checks pass: (1) valid column headers with invoice fields, (2) ≥8 service rows extracted to ensure all services were captured, (3) Domain Registration service exists anywhere in spreadsheet, (4) cell F6 contains 15.0 (±0.01), (5) ≥3 distinct services, (6) ≥3 typical invoice service keywords found. 0.0 otherwise
